subject: reasoning
question: Seven people, B, C, D, I, J, K and L, are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table. I sits to the immediate left of D. J is the immediate neighbour of both B and K. K sits third to the left of D. L is not an immediate neighbour of K. Who sits second to the right of C?
solution:
Given: Seven people, B, C, D, I, J, K and L, are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table.

I sits to the immediate left of D.

J is the immediate neighbour of both B and K.

K sits third to the left of D.

L is not an immediate neighbour of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3734972f697392d901757bc3e165b6af321d46e2bedecf627b4cd9fa113c2bda.png] 

Here, D sits second to the right of C.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
